channel.title: Paperspace incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Paperspace's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Service Disruption: Paperspace Console [resolved]
item.description:
Our Engineering team has confirmed that the issue preventing users from accessing or logging in to the Paperspace Console has been resolved, and the service has been fully restored.
Thank you for your patience and understanding throughout this incident. If you continue to experience any issues, please reach out to our Support team, and we will be happy to assist you further.

item.title: Service Disruption Identified: CORE CA1 [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved now.

item.title: Service Disruption Identified: CORE [resolved]
item.description: Our Engineering team has resolved the incident with intermittent connectivity issues affecting a few Core VMs in the NY2 data center. If you continue to experience problems, please open a ticket with our Support team. We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.

item.title: Degraded Performance: Core VM Start/Stop Delays and Internal Connectivity Issues [resolved]
GPU Instance Power-On Issues (NYC Region) [resolved]
item.description:
The issue affecting a subset of GPU instances in the NYC region has been resolved. Customers using P5000, P6000, and RTX5000 instances may have previously experienced difficulties when attempting to power on these resources.
Importantly, this issue had no impact on running instances, only power-on actions were affected.
Our engineering team has implemented a fix and is continuing to monitor the environment to ensure stability.
